simple.summary: רוֹמָם (rôwmâm) means exaltation , i.e. (figuratively and specifically) praise First listed occurrence: Ps 66 17.

definitions.full: H7318. romam רוֺמָם noun [masculine] extolling, praise ; — = song of praise (to ׳י ) Psa 66:17 , so read with van d. H., compare Thes Hup-Now Che Bae Buhl Lex ; > Ki Baer Gi verb Po`lal , רוֺמַם ; plural construct אֵל רוֺמְמוֺת Psa 149:6 .
